subject: HIPAA add-on: split billing & HSM-seat vs retention bundle
body:
From: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@healthedge.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Adam Park <security@healthedge.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: HIPAA add-on packaging — initial ask and usage profile

Hi Monica / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed with our Security team (Adam copied), we need a clear pricing path for three items so we can take a single number into procurement:

- Audit log retention (90/365/730 days) and attachment pricing for export
- KMS/HSM access model (per-seat vs pass-through vs flat monthly slab)
- Data residency: multi-region replica (US-only primary + EU read-only) and whether that’s a one-time activation fee or recurring charge

A few constraints from our end:
- We need SOC2/Security evidence for the audit logging pipeline as part of the PO.
- We expect 7M API calls/month initially; audit-log volume estimated ~120GB/month.
- Procurement prefers amortized implementation costs rather than a large one-off CAPEX where possible.

Can you share a bundled option that shows (a) a minimal pilot price and (b) committed 12‑ and 24‑month pricing with suggested discount tranches? Also any standard SOW language for HSM seat provisioning would be hugely helpful.

Lisa
Director, Procurement
HealthEdge Systems


On Thu, 17 Dec 2026 at 10:02 AM, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:

> From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
> To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@healthedge.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
> Cc: Adam Park <security@healthedge.com>
> Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
> Subject: RE: HIPAA add-on packaging — initial ask and usage profile
>
> Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a short spec and a rough pricing model to start (HIPAA_Addon_Specs.pdf, pricing-tranche-model.xlsx). Key highlights: 
>
> 1) Audit logs: three retention tiers (90/365/730). We price retention as a small monthly per-GB carry + a one-time ingestion indexing fee that we can amortize over the first 12 months. For your estimated 120GB/mo, the 365-day option lands at $X/month (I put ranges in the spreadsheet).
>
> 2) KMS/HSM: two recommended options — (A) HSM-seat: direct per-seat license + provisioning lead time (recommended for regulated workflows with frequent key rotations); (B) Pass-through billing: we invoice the cloud HSM usage at cost with a fixed platform fee. For pilots we typically waive the seat setup if you commit to 12 months.
>
> 3) Data residency: multi-region replica is a recurring addon (per-GB egress+replica storage) rather than a pure one-time activation. We can do an activation credit that reduces the first 3 months of recurring charges by up to 50% for a 24-month commit.
>
> Proposed next steps:
> - Ben and I will propose two bundle SKUs: Pilot (3 months, reduced retention, no HSM seat) and Enterprise (12/24 months, full retention, HSM-seat included).
> - I’ll include suggested SOW text for HSM provisioning and a sample audit evidence package.
> - If procurement wants amortization, we’ll show an option to amortize the indexing fee across 12 or 24 months in the quote.
>
> Attaching the SOW draft and the tranche model for transparency. Let me know if you want the model expressed as a blended per-token/per-log-line price instead of per-GB.
>
> Best,
> Monica Patel
> Sales (Compliance & Healthcare)
> Redwood Inference
>
> Attachments: HIPAA_Addon_Specs.pdf (pdf), pricing-tranche-model.xlsx (xlsx)


On Fri, 18 Dec 2026 at 08:45 AM, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:

> From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
> To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@healthedge.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
> Cc: Adam Park <security@healthedge.com>
> Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
> Subject: RE: HIPAA add-on packaging — initial ask and usage profile
>
> Hi Lisa — quick follow-up on pricing mechanics and discounting:
>
> - For a 12-month commit at your stated volumes (7M calls/mo, ~120GB logs/mo), we can offer a 15% platform discount and a 25% discount on the HSM-seat list if you take the Enterprise bundle (includes 365-day audit retention).
> - For a 24-month commit we can increase to 22% platform discount and provide an implementation credit that offsets the indexing fee entirely in months 1–6.
> - Pilot path: 3 months, standard rates, option to convert credits into invoice-level discounts on going-forward months.
>
> Procurement note: if you need amortization on the SOW invoice line, we will accept a PO with a payment schedule (monthly invoicing) but require the commit in the commercial sheet. I’ve sketched contract language in the attached Draft_SOW_Hipaa_Addon_v1.docx to support that approach.
>
> If you prefer to avoid HSM-seat license complexities, the pass-through approach keeps things simpler operationally (we keep key rotation hooks, you manage key policy in their KMS) — cost predictability vs control tradeoff.
>
> Happy to hop on a 30m call with procurement and security next week to lock details.
>
> Cheers,
> Ben Carter
> Account Executive, Strategic Sales
> Redwood Inference
>
> Attachment: Draft_SOW_Hipaa_Addon_v1.docx (docx)
>

>
> Team — quick approve to proceed with the 24-month concession outline.
>
> I’ve reviewed the tranche model and approve the following negotiating stance to present to HealthEdge:
>
> 1) Offer 24-month Enterprise bundle: 22% platform discount, HSM-seat 25% off list, implementation credit covering months 1–6 of indexing fee.
> 2) Keep pass-through HSM as fallback (no discount), but include language for conversion to seat license within the first 90 days with prorated credit.
> 3) Provide a single amortized SOW invoice option (monthly) and include a DocuSign-ready SOW.
>
> Monica — please send the updated quote and DocuSign SOW to Lisa and CC procurement. Ben — keep the pilot SKU alive if they want to start small; we can ladder into the 24-month commit.
>
> Jonas
> Head of Sales — Enterprise
> Redwood Inference
